title: Digits after increasing the length
statement: For natural numbers $b,n,c$, the list of the first $n+1$ base-$b$ remainders of $c$ is the list whose first term is $c\bmod b$ and whose remaining terms are the first $n$ remainders of $\lfloor c/b\rfloor$.
